comment: Data Refresh Policy configuration. All stages enabled+required; weather chunk size 1000 (=weather_etl.INSERT_CHUNK_SIZE); incremental weather ON after safety validation (set weather_incremental.enabled=false to restore full-range fetching).
failure_policy: continue-on-stage-failure (same as main_etl.py): remaining stages still run; exit code is non-zero if any REQUIRED stage did not finish SUCCESS.

weather_incremental.comment: Enabled in the shipped policy after the safety audit. Fetches weather from (per-airport watermark - overlap_days) instead of full flight history; set enabled=false to restore full-range fetching. Watermarks are written only after a successful stage + verification.
